venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 7/24.** MOD MKZ/JK. Net $6,480 vs target $6,251 (+3.7%); food $385, comps $81.65. 243 guests, $26.67 check avg. Rained almost the entire day — quiet start with MKZ opening; mid pushed back, closers in soon after. DJ's sound flawless as usual; steady & smooth night overall with no big pops. Reminders: check paper products at start of shift, bus glasses promptly to cut breakage. 86 Classic City Lager, very low High Life. Favorite moment: guests enjoying the DJ.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 7/24.** MOD KE/JMS. Net $11,000 vs target $9,542 (+15.3%); food $513, comps $77.50 (0.7%). 415 guests, $26.52 check avg. Early pop drove good food sales (Brandon C & Anna); good pace until things slowed ~12:30. Plenty of return guests plus new faces; several 6+ parties scattered through the night, including a 7-top birthday party Kala took great care of — they loved the sparkler candle. JM handled allergy questions and mods like a pro.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Hot beyond belief into evening rain
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 7/24.** AM MOD MS+WR; PM CJ+MS+WR+EF+JM. Total net $20,123.31 vs target $19,310 (+4.2%); D&C PM $18,485.29, DC/AM $1,638.02, Garden/6A $3,234.21, food $3,732.20. 398 guests plus garden, comps $786.49 (half DNLs — highest-DNL accounts also had highest sales). UMS festival next door: VIP lounge was a slow burn, major rain halted stage performances for hours; pivoted ~8:30 to seat waitlist guests in the VIP lounge with greater success (continuing through the weekend). Felix prepped caramel & mocha syrups; Telegraph and conference batches ready. Maintenance: service well, Bar 0500, and Garden fro-spro fridges temping high — perishables moved to keg cooler. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 7/24.** MOD Kyler & Steves. Net $7,833 vs target $7,921 (-1.1%); beverage $6,956, food $811, retail $66; comps $75.10 (1%). 217 guests, $36 check avg. A pretty chill Friday, but Haleigh kept the room afloat with lots of large and mid-sized parties — squeezing 6-tops into mid-sized tables to maximize the room. Mellow open, full at 8pm, big 10pm turn with friend groups galore (one self-named 'Squish Party'). Six birthdays plus National Tequila Day. Top sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, Peacemaker. One no-show (not charged).

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 7/24.** MOD Gigi & Saleh. Net $10,968 vs target $11,954 (-8.2%); Marquee $7,896, Standing Room $3,072; food $1,979; comps $252.24. 190 guests. Very sleepy first couple of hours in 100° heat — breaks knocked out early; action finally picked up 8:30/9pm and both rooms stayed full until midnight. SR very busy, drink rail in use; small rush after midnight with some slow ticket times but forgiving guests (shots and snax gifted). DK's friend Jeff and group had a great time with Jaz. 86 pale ale. Kitchen flagged late food orders after last call. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 7/24.** MOD Marcus/Josh. Net incl. events $8,863.79 vs target $8,480 (+4.5%); Marquee $7,847.85, Garden $1,015.94, food $893.50; comps $25.90 (0.28%), voids $188.20 (2.1%). 212 guests. Steady night with a strong start; Garden light/steady in amazing weather, closed by 11pm. Marquee picked back up ~10:30 with several larger walk-ins including an 8-top birthday — creative seating without turning anyone away. Hit the daily target. Favorite moment: tag-teaming a table and selling Chartreuse MOF and VEP.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Sunny, hot and humid, scattered storms
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 7/24.** (Report typed 2026-07-25 but Day=Friday; matched by post time.) AM MOD Sam & Lex; PM Justin & Marcus. Net $10,627 vs target $11,500 (-7.6%); Municipal AM $1,639, PM $8,382, Sun Club $366, Hot Eye $1,879; food $3,630; comps $487. Guests 242 (55 AM / 187 PM). Good happy-hour pop when rain started ~4:30; dining room fully sat by 7:30, waitlist 7-8:30, big exodus then half-refill by 9. Ran 4 servers with no SA/barback and stayed efficient. Sun Club very slow through the storm. Hot Eye quiet but steady with hotel guests and an industry pop. Kitchen: 4-count branzino. Happy birthday Justin!
